subject: MSA and order form — templates + signer authority check
messages:
From: Sara Liao <sara.liao@lumosanalytics.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumosanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: MSA and order form — templates + signer authority check

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this — Lumos is ready to start the MSA/order form review so we can get a POC running next quarter. I attached our initial redlines and a signer matrix (who's authorized to sign from our side). A few quick items we want to confirm up front: 

- Do you have a preferred MSA template you require teams to sign against, or do you accept counterparty redlines as a starting point?
- We have a DPA and SOC2 questions list; do you want those as separate exhibits or merged into the Order Form?
- Our procurement lead (procurement@lumosanalytics.com) needs a short timeline for legal review and signature so they can align internal approvals.

Attachments: Lumos-MSA-Initial-Redlines.pdf, Lumos-Signer-Matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Sara Liao
Senior Procurement Manager
Lumos Analytics

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Sara Liao <sara.liao@lumosanalytics.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA and order form — templates + signer authority check

Hi Sara — appreciated, and welcome. I pulled the attachments into our intake. A few clarifying Qs so we can frame legal's review and speed routing: 

- Redwood preference: we can route either our standard Redwood MSA (preferred for faster execution) or review your redlines. If Lumos needs to preserve specific clauses, call them out (e.g., data residency, indemnity caps).
- For the DPA/SOC2: we typically include a short data processing exhibit on the Order Form and reference our SOC2 report as a separate document. If Lumos requires narrative responses inside an exhibit, we'll map that in the intake.
- Signer authority: can you confirm whether the signer listed in the matrix has final exec signatory authority or whether procurement/corp dev needs to loop in legal/finance? That affects the sign-off path.

I attached our contract intake CSV and a blank MSA template mapping sheet to speed up alignment. Proposed timeline: intake/party mapping today, internal legal triage by EOD Thursday (09/24) if we get the completed matrix and any clause callouts. If you need an accelerated path we can request priority review but will need a short justification.

Next steps: can procurement send the completed signer matrix + any high-priority redlines by EOD today? I'll assign this to Karthik in legal for redline assessment.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood-Contract-Intake-Form.csv

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, Sara Liao <sara.liao@lumosanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA and order form — templates + signer authority check

Markus/Sara — looping in a quick note from contracting/ops side. We'll do a template-to-template gap map (Redwood MSA vs Lumos redlines) and flag three priority buckets for legal: 1) data protection/processing, 2) indemnity/liability/insurance, 3) payment/billing terms.

If Lumos can highlight the 2–3 clauses that are showstoppers for you, that will speed negotiation. Also please include your billing contact and invoicing cadence (monthly/quarterly/annual).

I will start the gap map this afternoon and hand to Karthik for legal review.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Contract Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: procurement@lumosanalytics.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Liao <sara.liao@lumosanalytics.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA and order form — templates + signer authority check

Hi Markus/Laura,

Thanks — attached is the completed signer matrix (Lumos-Signer-Matrix.xlsx) and a short note calling out two priority items: 1) a mutual indemnity cap of USD 1M, 2) a request that Redwood host SOC2 Type II evidence as an exhibit (rather than a third-party link). Billing contact: finance@lumosanalytics.com, invoicing quarterly.

We can accept your Redwood MSA if the two items above are captured in the first-pass markup; procurement would like legal's quick read so we can align our VP signature next week. Our team is happy to do a 30-minute sync if that helps.

Attachments: Lumos-Signer-Matrix.xlsx, Lumos-Top-Clauses.txt

Best,
Procurement Team
Lumos Analytics
